items.title_cn: 复发性高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎：风险分层、代谢易感性与二级预防
items.title_en: Recurrent Hypertriglyceridemic Acute Pancreatitis: Risk Stratification, Metabolic Susceptibility, and Secondary Prevention
items.abstract_cn: 高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）日益常见，尤其是在合并代谢性共病的患者中。其管理不仅限于急性发作期间的降甘油三酯（TG）治疗：临床医生必须确认病因归属、处理可逆性驱动因素、评估个体易感性，并在出院前启动可持续的预防方案。复发反映了长期TG负荷、代谢和遗传易感性、其他胰腺危险因素以及随访缺口。与侧重于本次住院期间的急性降TG策略不同，二级预防需要对代谢暴露、个体易感性和治疗持久性进行纵向评估。在此我们描述我们的SMART方法，该方法将这些任务组织为：筛查与确认（Screen and confirm）、修正触发因素（Modify triggers）、评估易感性（Assess susceptibility）、降低TG负荷（Reduce TG burden）以及追踪与定制长期管理（Track and tailor long-term management）。
items.abstract_en: Hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) is increasingly encountered, particularly among patients with metabolic comorbidities. Management extends beyond triglyceride (TG) lowering during the acute episode: clinicians must confirm etiologic attribution, address reversible drivers, assess individual susceptibility, and initiate a sustainable prevention plan before discharge. Recurrence reflects longitudinal TG burden, metabolic and genetic susceptibility, other pancreatic risk factors, and gaps in follow-up. Unlike acute TG-lowering strategies, which focus on the index hospitalization, secondary prevention requires longitudinal assessment of metabolic exposure, individual susceptibility, and treatment durability. Here we describe our SMART approach, which organizes these tasks as Screen and confirm, Modify triggers, Assess susceptibility, Reduce TG burden, and Track and tailor long-term management.
items.summary_cn: 该论文聚焦高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）的复发问题，提出管理不应仅限于急性期降TG，而需在出院前确认病因、处理可逆诱因、评估个体易感性并启动可持续的二级预防。作者提出SMART框架（筛查确认、修正诱因、评估易感性、降低TG负荷、长期追踪与个体化管理）来组织这些任务。

items.title_cn: 感染性假性囊肿和感染性包裹性坏死的升阶梯治疗策略：一项前瞻性观察性研究
items.title_en: Step-up strategy for the treatment of infected pseudocysts and infected walled-off necrosis: a prospective observational study
items.abstract_cn: 背景。感染性假性囊肿和感染性包裹性坏死（WON）是急性胰腺炎的严重并发症，开放手术后死亡率较高（高达35%）。腔道对合金属支架（LAMS）的使用使微创内镜引流成为可能；然而，关于分期内镜下清创过程中实验室炎症标志物动态变化和腔腔消退的数据仍不充分。目的——评估使用LAMS进行透壁引流后行分期内镜下清创和坏死组织清除术在感染性假性囊肿和感染性包裹性坏死患者中的疗效和安全性。方法。一项前瞻性观察性单中心研究于2019年1月至2025年3月进行。共纳入43例感染性假性囊肿或感染性包裹性坏死患者。所有患者均接受超声内镜引导下透壁引流，置入10 mm LAMS，随后对感染性假性囊肿行分期清创，对感染性包裹性坏死行分期坏死组织清除术。主要结局指标为C反应蛋白（CRP）水平和腔腔容积的动态变化。统计分析采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验。结果。中位CRP从入院时的132.7（53.1; 190.2）mg/L降至出院时的43.6（14.8; 76.1）（p 0.001）。腔腔容积从344.8（88.9; 830.2）降至11.2（5.3; 16.4）cm³（p 0.001），消退率达94.2%。共记录30例不良事件，其中发热最常见（20例，占所有并发症的66.7%）。危及生命的并发症（囊肿穿孔、侵蚀性出血）需要开腹手术的有5例（11.6%）。死亡率为2.3%。在内镜治疗无效的患者中，初始腔腔容积超过1000 mL，坏死组织块大小超过5 cm。结论。使用LAMS进行内镜透壁引流联合分期清创可有效控制感染性假性囊肿和感染性包裹性坏死患者的炎症，并实现腔腔几乎完全消退。对于腔腔容积 1000 mL且坏死组织块较大（ 5 cm）的病例，应考虑联合引流技术（经皮引流、视频辅助腹膜后清创术）。
items.abstract_en: Background. Infected pseudocysts and infected walled-off necrosis (WON) are severe complications of acute pancreatitis associated with high mortality rates (up to 35%) following open surgery. The use of lumen-apposing metal stents (LAMS) enables minimally invasive endoscopic drainage; however, data on the dynamics of laboratory inflammatory markers and cavity regression during staged endoscopic debridement remain insufficient. Aims — to evaluate the efficacy and safety of transmural drainage using LAMS followed by staged endoscopic debridement and necrosectomy in patients with infected pseudocysts and infected walled-off necrosis. Methods. A prospective observational single-center study was conducted from January 2019 to March 2025. A total of 43 patients with infected pseudocysts or infected walled-off necrosis were enrolled. All patients underwent endoscopic ultrasound-guided transmural drainage with a 10-mm LAMS, followed by staged debridement for infected pseudocysts and staged necrosectomy for infected walled-off necrosis. The primary outcomes were the dynamics of C-reactive protein (CRP) levels and cavity volume. Statistical analysis was performed using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test. Results. Median CRP decreased from 132.7 (53.1; 190.2) mg/L at admission to 43.6 (14.8; 76.1) at discharge (p 0.001). Cavity volume decreased from 344.8 (88.9; 830.2) to 11.2 (5.3; 16.4) cm³ (p 0.001), representing a regression of 94.2%. A total of 30 adverse events were recorded, with hyperthermia being the most common (20 cases, 66.7% of all complications). Life-threatening complications (cyst perforation, erosive bleeding) required laparotomy in 5 patients (11.6%). Mortality was 2.3%. In patients with ineffective endoscopic treatment, the initial cavity volume exceeded 1000 mL and sequestrum size exceeded 5 cm. Conclusions. Endoscopic transmural drainage with LAMS and staged debridement effectively controls inflammation and achieves almost complete cavity regression in patients with infected pseudocysts and infected walled-off necrosis. In cases with cavity volume 1000 mL and large sequestra ( 5 cm), combined drainage techniques (percutaneous drainage, video-assisted retroperitoneal debridement) should be considered.
items.journal: Annals of the Russian academy of medical sciences
items.summary_cn: 该前瞻性研究显示，对感染性假性囊肿和感染性包裹性坏死（WON）患者采用10-mm LAMS行EUS引导下透壁引流并分期清创/坏死清除术，可使CRP从入院中位132.7 mg/L降至出院43.6 mg/L，腔体积缩小94.2%，死亡率2.3%；但初始腔体积>1000 mL且坏死组织>5 cm者内镜疗效不佳，需考虑联合经皮引流或视频辅助腹膜后清创。

items.title_cn: 白细胞介素17在重症急性胰腺炎中的作用：人体回顾性初步研究
items.title_en: Role of Interleukin 17 in Severe Acute Pancreatitis: Human Retrospective Pilot Study
items.abstract_cn: 背景/目的：重症急性胰腺炎占急性胰腺炎发作的20%，并具有较高的死亡风险。该疾病的全身严重程度由大量细胞因子释放驱动，其中白细胞介素-17（IL-17）作为促炎级联反应的关键调节因子发挥作用。本研究旨在评估入院时血清IL-17对重症急性胰腺炎的预后价值，并将其与多器官功能障碍及临床-生物学结局进行相关性分析。方法：对35例重症急性胰腺炎患者队列进行回顾性分析。提取人口学、病因学及临床-生物学基线特征。采用ELISA法测定入院时血清IL-17水平，并对数据进行统计分析。结果：在发生多器官衰竭的患者中观察到IL-17水平显著升高。通过ROC分析确定了预测器官功能障碍的预后阈值：神经系统功能障碍（AUC = 0.814，p = 0.003）和急性呼吸窘迫综合征（AUC = 0.756，p = 0.024）为≥19.77 pg/mL；呼吸功能障碍（p = 0.004）和心血管功能障碍（AUC = 0.820，p = 0.002）为≥18.45 pg/mL；肾功能障碍（AUC = 0.735，p = 0.020）为≥19.81 pg/mL。此外，单因素二元logistic回归分析确定，血清IL-17升高是入住重症监护病房患者死亡的重要预后因素（OR = 1.062，p = 0.048）。结论：入院时血清IL-17作为一种重要的预后生物标志物，反映了重症急性胰腺炎严重的全身促炎状态，并反映了后续器官功能障碍和死亡的风险。将IL-17纳入初始风险分层方案可能有助于临床医生及时升级治疗。
items.abstract_en: Background/Objectives: Severe acute pancreatitis accounts for 20% of acute pancreatitis episodes and carries a substantial mortality risk. The systematic severity of the disease is driven by a massive cytokine release, with Interleukin-17 (IL-17) acting as a crucial modulator of the pro-inflammatory cascade. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic value of serum IL-17 at admission and correlate it with multi-organ dysfunctions and clinical-biological outcomes in patients with severe acute pancreatitis. Methods: A retrospective analysis was conducted on a cohort of 35 patients with severe acute pancreatitis. Demographic, etiological, and clinical-biological baseline characteristics were extracted. Serum IL-17 levels were determined at admission using the ELISA method, and data were statistically analyzed. Results: Significantly higher levels of IL-17 were observed in patients who developed multi-organ failure. Prognostic thresholds were identified via ROC analysis to predict organ dysfunctions: ≥19.77 pg/mL for neurological dysfunction (AUC = 0.814, p = 0.003) and acute respiratory distress syndrome (AUC = 0.756, p = 0.024); ≥18.45 pg/mL for respiratory (p = 0.004) and cardiovascular dysfunctions (AUC = 0.820, p = 0.002); and ≥19.81 pg/mL for renal dysfunction (AUC = 0.735, p = 0.020). Furthermore, univariate binary logistic regression identified elevated serum IL-17 as a significant prognostic factor for mortality among patients admitted to the intensive care unit (OR = 1.062, p = 0.048). Conclusions: Serum IL-17 at admission functions as a significant prognostic biomarker that reflects the severe systemic pro-inflammatory status in severe acute pancreatitis and mirrors the risk of subsequent organ dysfunctions and mortality. Incorporating IL-17 into initial risk stratification protocols may assist clinicians in timely therapeutic escalation.
items.summary_cn: 在35例重症急性胰腺炎患者中，入院时血清IL-17水平升高与多器官功能障碍（包括神经、呼吸、心血管和肾脏功能障碍）显著相关，ROC分析确定了预测各器官功能障碍的阈值（如神经功能障碍≥19.77 pg/mL，AUC=0.814）。此外，升高的血清IL-17是ICU患者死亡的重要预后因素（OR=1.062，p=0.048）。

items.title_cn: 白细胞介素17联合全身参数在中重度急性胰腺炎严重程度分层和死亡率预测中的作用
items.title_en: The Role of Interleukin 17 in Association with Systemic Parameters in Severity Stratification and Mortality Prediction in Moderate and Severe Acute Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 引言：急性胰腺炎是一种炎症性病变，可导致多器官功能障碍，并具有较高的死亡率。其发病机制复杂，核心要素之一是全身性炎症。本探索性研究旨在识别有助于对中度和重度急性胰腺炎进行严重程度分层和死亡预测的参数，以及评估IL-17对疾病严重程度的预测价值。材料与方法：在2024年10月至2025年8月期间，对64例符合条件的中度和重度急性胰腺炎患者进行了回顾性研究。根据观察表、病史和临床检查收集人口学、病因学和生物学数据。同时，采用ELISA技术对IL-17水平进行定量检测。所有数据均进行了适当的统计学分析。结果：在64例病例中，35例（54.69%）为重度急性胰腺炎。从临床-人口学数据中，我们确定个人心血管和肾脏病理既往史是死亡的独立危险因素（分别为OR = 7.529和OR = 24）。此外，代谢性病因是死亡的危险因素（OR = 5.625）。在生物学参数中，红细胞沉降率≥ 41.29 mm/h和AISI评分≥ 1627.50在预测严重程度方面具有较高的敏感性和特异性。白细胞增多、C反应蛋白（CRP）、IL-17和低钙血症是发生重度急性胰腺炎的预测危险因素（分别为OR = 3.733、OR = 1.136、OR = 1.068和OR = 3.542）。其中，仅CRP、IL-17和低钙血症是死亡的危险因素（OR = 1.051、OR = 1.080、OR = 6.771）。关于住院管理中的重症监护天数，并发症和器官功能障碍是死亡的危险因素。结论：本研究识别了可作为当前评分系统辅助手段的有用参数，用于对中度和重度急性胰腺炎患者进行严重程度分层，以及识别死亡危险因素。此外，IL-17提供了参与这些患者发病机制、严重程度演变和生存的有用信息。尽管IL-17具有前景广阔的作用，但由于样本量较小，这些发现仍属初步结果，需要外部验证。
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Acute pancreatitis is an inflammatory lesion that can lead to multiple organ dysfunctions and has an increased mortality rate. The pathogenic mechanisms are complex. A central element is represented by systemic inflammation. This exploratory study aims to identify parameters useful in stratifying the severity of moderate and severe acute pancreatitis and predicting mortality, as well as in evaluating the predictive value of IL-17 regarding disease severity. Material and Methods: A retrospective study was conducted during the period October 2024–August 2025 on an eligible group of 64 patients with moderate and severe acute pancreatitis. Demographic, etiological, and biological data were collected according to the observation sheets, anamnesis, and clinical examination. Also, the level of IL-17 was quantified by the ELISA technique. All data were appropriately analyzed statistically. Results: Of the 64 cases, 35 (54.69%) had severe acute pancreatitis. From the clinical–demographic data, we identified personal cardiovascular and renal pathological antecedents as independent risk factors for death (OR = 7.529 and OR = 24, respectively). Also, metabolic etiology represented a risk factor for death (OR = 5.625). From the biological parameters, erythrocyte sedimentation rate ≥ 41.29 mm/h and AISI score ≥ 1627.50 have a role in predicting severity with quite high sensitivity and specificity. Leukocytosis, C-reactive protein (CRP), IL-17, and hypocalcemia represent predictive risk factors for the occurrence of severe acute pancreatitis (OR = 3.733, OR = 1.136, OR = 1.068, and OR = 3.542, respectively). Of these, only CRP, IL-17, and hypocalcemia represent risk factors for death (OR = 1.051, OR = 1.080, OR = 6.771). Regarding the in-hospital management of intensive care days, complications and organ dysfunctions are risk factors for death. Conclusions: This study identified useful parameters adjunct to the current scoring systems to stratify patient severity in moderate and severe acute pancreatitis, as well as risk factors for mortality. In addition, IL-17 provides useful information involved in the pathogenesis, evolution of severity and survival in these patients. Despite the promising role of IL-17, these findings remain preliminary due to the small sample size and require external validation.
items.summary_cn: 该回顾性研究在64例中重度急性胰腺炎患者中发现，IL-17、CRP和低钙血症是死亡的危险因素，而ESR≥41.29 mm/h和AISI评分≥1627.50有助于预测病情严重程度；心血管和肾脏基础疾病及代谢性病因也是死亡的独立危险因素。

items.title_cn: 已发表的预测因素集与急性胰腺炎后复发性事件负担：一项单中心回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Published predictor set and recurrent-event burden after acute pancreatitis: a retrospective single-center cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 复发性急性胰腺炎（RAP）在首次急性胰腺炎（AP）发作后较为常见，但已发表的RAP模型通常为推导研究，且很少关注复发性事件负担。在这项回顾性单中心队列研究中，我们连续纳入了2018年1月1日至2021年10月31日期间首次因AP入院后出院的成年患者，并在行政层面将随访截断至出院后36个月，即截至2024年10月31日。主要终点为出院后36个月内首次RAP；次要终点为RAP总发作次数，慢性胰腺炎（CP）进展以描述性方式总结。死亡记录为随访结局/删失信息。已发表的二元列线图所报告的四个预测因子被拟合为可重复的、来源于原始研究的本地Cox比较模型。未评估未经修改的原始模型的绝对风险。另建了一个全新的本地Cox模型，并通过嵌套多重插补bootstrap进行内部验证，总事件负担采用Prentice–Williams–Peterson间隔时间模型进行分析。全部859例患者均贡献了随访至首次RAP、死亡、末次接触或36个月的随访数据；15例无事件患者在36个月前失访，14例死亡。322例患者观察到首次RAP（粗比例37.5%），共分析693次复发事件。来源于原始研究的四变量本地比较模型的乐观校正Uno's C为0.69（95% CI 0.66–0.72），而全新本地Cox模型为0.74（95% CI 0.72–0.77）；后者36个月Brier评分为0.174（95% CI 0.158–0.190）。表观风险分层可区分累积复发性事件负担。79例患者（9.2%）发生CP进展。在这项回顾性单中心队列研究中，使用已发表预测因子集拟合的本地模型显示出中等程度的内部验证区分度，而另建的全新本地模型显示出更高的内部验证性能。复发性事件方法在首次复发时间之外提供了额外的负担信息；在临床使用前需要独立的多中心验证。
items.abstract_en: Recurrent acute pancreatitis (RAP) is common after a first acute pancreatitis (AP) episode, but published RAP models are usually derivation studies and rarely address recurrent-event burden. In this retrospective single-center cohort, we enrolled consecutive adults whose index discharge after a first AP admission occurred between January 1, 2018, and October 31, 2021, and administratively truncated follow-up at 36 months after discharge through October 31, 2024. The primary endpoint was first post-discharge RAP within 36 months; secondary endpoints were total RAP episodes, and chronic pancreatitis (CP) progression was summarized descriptively. Mortality was recorded as follow-up disposition/censoring information. The four predictors reported by a published binary nomogram were fitted as a reproducible, source-informed local Cox comparator. No unmodified-source-model absolute risk was evaluated. A separate de novo local Cox model was internally validated with nested multiple-imputation bootstrap, and total event burden was analyzed with a Prentice–Williams–Peterson gap-time model. All 859 patients contributed follow-up through first RAP, death, last contact, or 36 months; 15 event-free patients were lost before 36 months and 14 died. First RAP was observed in 322 patients (crude proportion 37.5%), and 693 recurrent episodes were analyzed. The optimism-corrected Uno’s C was 0.69 (95% CI 0.66–0.72) for the source-informed four-variable local comparator and 0.74 (95% CI 0.72–0.77) for the de novo local Cox model; the latter had a 36-month Brier score of 0.174 (95% CI 0.158–0.190). Apparent risk strata separated cumulative recurrent-event burden. CP progression occurred in 79 patients (9.2%). In this retrospective single-center cohort, a locally fitted model using the published predictor set showed moderate internally validated discrimination, while a separate de novo local model showed higher internally validated performance. Recurrent-event methods added burden information beyond time to first recurrence; independent multicenter validation is required before clinical use.
items.summary_cn: 该回顾性单中心队列研究纳入859例首次急性胰腺炎出院患者，发现36个月内37.5%出现复发性急性胰腺炎，共分析693次复发事件；基于已发表四变量预测集的本地Cox模型内部验证区分度中等（Uno's C 0.69），而新构建的本地Cox模型表现更优（C 0.74），复发事件负担分析提供了超越首次复发时间的信息，9.2%患者进展为慢性胰腺炎。

items.title_cn: 新型炎症标志物SII、SIRI、AISI和MII在重症急性胰腺炎识别中应用的临床研究
items.title_en: A clinical study on the application of new inflammatory markers SII, SIRI, AISI, and MII in the identification of severe acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 背景 急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种以突然发作为特征的炎症性疾病。如果进展为重症急性胰腺炎（SAP），死亡率会显著升高。目前的临床评分系统较为复杂。因此，临床需要一种廉价、快速、准确且易于使用的新型炎症标志物。在此，我们旨在评估以下新型炎症标志物在入院时预测SAP以及入院后48 h评估AP严重程度的临床价值：全身免疫炎症指数（SII）、全身炎症反应指数（SIRI）、全身炎症综合指数（AISI）、多炎症指数-I（MII-1）、多炎症指数-II（MII-2）、多炎症指数-III（MII-3）。方法 对石家庄市人民医院收治的374例AP患者进行回顾性分析，其中重症组58例，非重症组316例。采用受试者工作特征曲线分析和成对DeLong检验比较各标志物的性能。针对每种炎症标志物分别构建多变量logistic回归模型，并校正临床因素。使用2,000次bootstrap重抽样对校正模型进行内部验证。结果 SII、SIRI、AISI、MII-1、MII-2和MII-3均为AP严重程度的统计学显著指标（P < 0.05）。入院时，这些炎症标志物对SAP的总体预测性能相对有限，AUC范围为0.589至0.694；SII的AUC最高，为0.694。入院后48 h，MII-1、MII-2和MII-3在评估AP严重程度方面表现出中等至良好的区分性能，AUC分别为0.790、0.778和0.780。校正临床因素后，所有三个MII指数仍与SAP显著相关。校正后的MII-1、MII-2和MII-3模型在入院后48 h的表观AUC分别为0.819、0.807和0.804，乐观校正后的AUC分别为0.800、0.786和0.783。结论 MII-1、MII-2和MII-3在入院后48 h评估AP严重程度方面表现出中等至良好的区分性能，尤其是MII-1，并且在校正临床因素后，它们与SAP的相关性仍然显著。这些发现应被视为探索性和生成假设性的，仍需进一步研究以验证MII指数在AP严重程度评估中的潜在价值。
items.abstract_en: Background Acute pancreatitis (AP) is an inflammatory disease characterized by sudden onset. The mortality rate increases significantly if it progresses to severe acute pancreatitis (SAP). Current clinical scoring systems are complex. Consequently, there is a clinical need for novel inflammatory markers that are inexpensive, fast, accurate, and easy to use. Herein, we aimed to evaluate the clinical value of the following novel inflammatory markers for predicting SAP at admission and assessing AP severity at 48 h after admission: the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), systemic inflammatory response index (SIRI), aggregate index of systemic inflammation (AISI), multi-inflammatory index-I (MII-1), multi-inflammatory index-II (MII-2), multi-inflammatory index-III (MII-3). Methods A retrospective analysis was conducted on 374 patients with AP hospitalized at Shijiazhuang People's Hospital, including 58 cases in the severe group and 316 cases in the non-severe group. Receiver operating characteristic curve analysis and pairwise DeLong tests were used to compare marker performance. Separate multivariable logistic regression models were constructed for each inflammatory marker with adjustment for clinical factors. Internal validation of the adjusted models was performed using 2,000 bootstrap resamples. Results The SII, SIRI, AISI, MII-1, MII-2, and MII-3 emerged as statistically significant ( P < 0.05) indicators of AP severity. At admission, the overall predictive performance of the inflammatory markers for SAP was relatively limited, with AUCs ranging from 0.589 to 0.694; SII showed the highest AUC of 0.694. At 48 h after admission, MII-1, MII-2, and MII-3 showed moderate-to-good discriminatory performance for assessing AP severity, with AUCs of 0.790, 0.778, and 0.780, respectively. After adjustment for clinical factors, all three MII indices remained significantly associated with SAP. The adjusted MII-1, MII-2, and MII-3 models yielded apparent AUCs of 0.819, 0.807, and 0.804 at 48 h after admission, with optimism-corrected AUCs of 0.800, 0.786, and 0.783. Conclusion MII-1, MII-2, and MII-3 showed moderate-to-good discriminatory performance for assessing AP severity at 48 h after admission, particularly MII-1, and their associations with SAP remained significant after adjustment for clinical factors. These findings should be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating, and further studies are needed to validate the potential value of MII indices in AP severity assessment.
items.summary_cn: 该研究评估了SII、SIRI、AISI及MII系列新型炎症标志物对急性胰腺炎严重程度的预测价值，发现入院时各标志物预测SAP的AUC仅为0.589-0.694，而入院48小时后MII-1、MII-2、MII-3对AP严重程度具有中等至良好的判别能力（AUC分别为0.790、0.778、0.780），校正临床因素后仍与SAP显著相关（校正后AUC为0.800、0.786、0.783）。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
